grok: Grok worked on 20 of 20 invoices (83 API calls this run; reused cached answers are not counted as calls). Hard rules rejected 12 of them; Grok cannot turn those into a payment: it cross-checked the reading, reviewed each rejection (it can only escalate one to a person) and wrote the memo.
